title: Sun fun and Buns

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Hey, hey, you made it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey, you made it!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well, ain't you sweet. I love it here. Beautiful place, beautiful people. The city can be so gloomy sometimes. A little sun and fun is a good thing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, ain't you sweet. I love it here. Beautiful place, beautiful people. The city can be so gloomy sometimes. A little sun and fun is a good thing!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Eh, well, it didn't pan out the way I thought, but their deposit cleared so next round's on me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, well, it didn't pan out the way I thought, but their deposit cleared so next round's on me!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Haha, that's the groove! See those lights over there? The ones reflecting off the water? I want to make a display like that, something aquatic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, that's the groove! See those lights over there? The ones reflecting off the water? I want to make a display like that, something aquatic.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Difference of opinion. The problem with being an artist is finding work. The problem with working as an artist is not selling your soul.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Difference of opinion. The problem with being an artist is finding work. The problem with working as an artist is not selling your soul.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Indeed. But for now we've got sun, sand, surf, and oh hey look at her. Got some buns too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. But for now we've got sun, sand, surf, and oh hey look at her. Got some buns too.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: If it makes them happy who are you to tell them to cover up? You don't have to look, just like they don't have to look at you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it makes them happy who are you to tell them to cover up? You don't have to look, just like they don't have to look at you.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: That's 'cause you've seen me on the dance floor. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's 'cause you've seen me on the dance floor. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: A conversationalist by trade. Hmmm. I wouldn't have figured you for one of those. Keep on surprisin' me, darlin', I kinda like it. So, tell me, you flying solo or are we just flirting for fun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A conversationalist by trade. Hmmm. I wouldn't have figured you for one of those. Keep on surprisin' me, darlin', I kinda like it. So, tell me, you flying solo or are we just flirting for fun?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Mmmmm. Those are where the treats lie. So, tell me, darlin, you flyin' solo or are we just flirting for fun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmmmm. Those are where the treats lie. So, tell me, darlin, you flyin' solo or are we just flirting for fun?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ooohhh, and what are you hoping to find out THERE?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ooohhh, and what are you hoping to find out THERE?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well, then you're in luck because so am I and I got some time on my hands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, then you're in luck because so am I and I got some time on my hands.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Mhm. And what about you? Do you have one and we're just flirtin' for fun? Or are you flying solo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhm. And what about you? Do you have one and we're just flirtin' for fun? Or are you flying solo?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Damn is right. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn is right. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: All casu-al. Nice. If only everything were that easy we'd all be livin' like this in the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All casu-al. Nice. If only everything were that easy we'd all be livin' like this in the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Not all treasure is stuff you can spend. Just saying, darlin'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not all treasure is stuff you can spend. Just saying, darlin'.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: How 'bout we take this party to the sky? Meet me in the Gardens. I gotta square up with my contract here, make sure they aren't trashing my name cross the nets. See yah there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How 'bout we take this party to the sky? Meet me in the Gardens. I gotta square up with my contract here, make sure they aren't trashing my name cross the nets. See yah there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I appreciate the invite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate the invite.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How'd the job go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd the job go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just wanted to see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just wanted to see you again.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just wanted to see you again.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just wanted to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well then, I'll have what you're having!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well then, I'll have what you're having!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well then, I'll have what you're having!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well then, I'll have what you're having!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure someone as bright as you will figure something out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure someone as bright as you will figure something out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure someone as bright as you will figure something out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure someone as bright as you will figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Capitalism.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Capitalism.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Daaammmnnn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Daaammmnnn.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not as nice as yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not as nice as yours.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People should have more modesty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People should have more modesty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eyes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eyes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Physique.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Physique.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All about the chat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All about the chat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not solo, but not a duet either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not solo, but not a duet either.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not solo, but not a duet either.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not solo, but not a duet either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm taken, but there's no harm in fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm taken, but there's no harm in fun.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm taken, but there's no harm in fun.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm taken, but there's no harm in fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Solo as can be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Solo as can be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lots of sea to sail out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lots of sea to sail out there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Lots of sea to sail out there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Lots of sea to sail out there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just more of a get-to-know-you kind of person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just more of a get-to-know-you kind of person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm just more of a get-to-know-you kind of person.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm just more of a get-to-know-you kind of person.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: True! Everyone has to find their bit of happiness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: True! Everyone has to find their bit of happiness.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: True! Everyone has to find their bit of happiness.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: True! Everyone has to find their bit of happiness.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This island's not so bad right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This island's not so bad right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This island's not so bad right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This island's not so bad right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the plan then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the plan then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Treasure!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Treasure!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: True love.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: True love.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone to rock the boat with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone to rock the boat with.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Someone to rock the boat with.
